title: LGC-Net: Lightweight Book Cover Layout Generation for On-Premises Publishing Design
description: LGC-Net is a lightweight conditional variational autoencoder for editable book-cover layout generation in on-premises publishing design. This archive contains the standalone model implementation, the final M-32-G two-stage protocol, training and evaluation utilities, unified metrics, baseline adapters and patches, and machine-readable reported results. It does not contain original book-cover image pixels, model checkpoints, third-party source repositories, or unpublished negative-space experiments.
